notes.title: Update 1.3.0 - The Essence of Butter
notes.content:
This update contains many optimizations that will hopefully solve some of your frame rate issues. Please note, if it doesn't solve your performance issues, do not worry, this will be the first of many updates that contain optimizations.

[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*]Added icon to highlight in-game chat messages on the kill feed
[*]Added sound when health starts regenerating
[*]Added gun dry fire sound
[*]Added "Barreled" medal (Get a kill by blowing up a barrel)
[*]Added "Hail Mary" medal (Get a long distance frag grenade kill)
[*]Added "Turkey Ball" medal (Kill someone right after they Rogi Ball teleport)
[*]Added "Pleb Step" medal (Kill someone right after you Rogi Ball teleport)
[*]Added "News Flash" medal (Get a kill by shooting a frag grenade)
[*]Added "S.Y.K.S.Y.L" medal (Stole your kill, stole your life)
[*]Added another shotgun spawner in Rogi Park
[*]Added more non-power weapon spawners to Rogi Park and Web Island
[*]Added explosive barrels to Web Island and Meta World
[*]Added visual effect to "Capturing" text in Siege gamemodes
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Rogi Ball deals explosive damage at both old and new positions
[*]Increased default shotgun range
[*]Reduced default starting frag grenades value to 1
[*]Weapon drops from spawners (not dropped by players) aren't affected by physics
[*]Weapon pick-up indicator shows closest weapon when near multiple weapon drops
[*]Crosshair gets slightly smaller when aimed at an enemy (Visual effect only)
[*]Changed Rogi Ball image
[*]Changed "Stuck" medal image
[*]Grenades awarded from random item boxes are now auto-selected
[*]Reduced volume on button highlight sound
[*]Renamed "Classic Siege" to "Siege Deathmatch"
[*]Changed "Shotty Snipers" game modes to spawn item boxes
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed points from medals not checking for wins
[*]Fixed points from medals not contributing to team score
[*]Fixed acceleration setting changing speed instead
[*]Fixed issue with scoring value randomly reverting after several games
[*]Fixed scoreboard showing behind other HUD elements
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.2.0 - Custom Game Modes
notes.content:
[b]Custom game modes now available![/b]
When hosting a lobby, click the game mode button to open the menu. Choose a built-in game mode as a starting point and click "Save as new". You can now edit all sorts of settings related to scoring, weapons, grenades, power-ups, movement, and more.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DYRvn1g.png[/img]

[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*]Added custom game modes
[*]Added some new shirts, pants, and shoes customization options
[*]Added "Mini Siege" game mode (Siege that's better for small maps)
[*]Added [b]Erdentempel[/b] map prototype. This is a prototype with incomplete visuals and gameplay. I want to see how it plays, and how to make it better before making it look pretty.
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Removed IP address from lobby
[*]Bots are worse at knifing (now based on difficulty)
[*]Reduced game over screen duration
[*]Made "Siege - Captures Only" the standard version of Siege, and renamed the old one "Classic Siege"
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed initial spawn points in Meta World
[*]Fixed knifing while respawning EDIT: It's only fixed on host...
[*]Fixed tesla grenade shock effect randomly shocking nothing
[*]Fixed tesla grenade shock effect drawing only straight lines
[*]Fixed collision box on shotgun drop
[/list]

-Minor optimizations. Very minor, but not the end of the optimizations. I'm aware some players are having frame rate issues. I will always be looking for ways to make it run smoother. I am a firm believer that no one should have to play with less than 60 fps.

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 - A City By Citizens
notes.content:
[b]New game mode: Heatmatch[/b]
Get kills, earn medals, and deal damage quickly to increase your heat index. Earn points per second equal to your heat index. Reach high levels of heat to deal explosive damage to nearby players.
[b]Check it out: [/b][url=https://youtu.be/uETAzK9i8Ts]HERE[/url] (YouTube)

[b]Scoring update for Moon Base[/b]
[list]
[*]1 point: standard kills
[*]2 points: direct rocket hits
[*]3 points: sticky grenade kill (must stick player)
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Siege - Captures Only:[/b] Changed score to win to 3
[*][b]Moon Base:[/b] Changed sticky grenade spawn amount to 1
[*]Added "Stuck" medal
[*]Added "Not In Minnesota" medal (only in Heatmatch)
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]"Direct Hit" medal now shows on kill feed
[*]Disconnected players on scoreboard have grey text
[/list]

[b]NOTE: [/b]The next thing I'm going to be working on is expanding the game's online presence with social media, streamers, etc. with hopes to get more players online so it's easier to find matches. Therefore, it may be a few weeks before another game update, unless there are serious bugs. Thank you very much to everyone who has played Versus World so far, and I promise to make increasing concurrent players a top priority!
-Justin
